budgets.title: naming 150 orders takes a couple of batches, not 150 round trips
budgets.why: One fetch per order is the N+1 problem: the same forty customers are fetched over and over. Collect the distinct ids first, fetch them in batches of at most 25, then answer from what came back.

budgets.title: a missing customer costs nothing extra
budgets.why: An id that does not exist simply comes back absent. It must not turn into a retry, a second lookup, or a fetch of everything.

budgets.title: two hops are two rounds of batches, not two fetches per order
budgets.why: The second hop cannot start until the first has answered, so it is a second ROUND — not a reason to fetch per order. Batch the customers, learn their regions, then batch the regions.
